pages.text: Everything lives under $(thing)/element$().$(br2)$(li)$(thing)/element debug$() - toggles a per-player debug mode. While on, every attack prints its damage formula and every reaction explains why it triggered or failed. This is the fastest way to understand the system.$(li)$(thing)/element reload$() - reloads all config files immediately.$(br2)$(thing)debug$() works for any player; every other subcommand requires permission level 2.

pages.title: Immunity blacklists
pages.text: Hold a $(thing)spawn egg$() and run:$(br2)$(thing)/element blacklist <type> add$()$(br2)$(li)$(l)types:$() $(thing)frostbite, paralysis, static, scorched, spore, steam, wetness, freeze$() (plus $(thing)caster$() if Iron's Spells is loaded)$(li)$(thing)remove$() with the same egg undoes it$(li)$(thing)list$() prints the current list$(br2)Requires permission level 2. The entity is written to the matching config file and takes effect immediately.

pages.title: Forced items
pages.text: Hold the item and run:$(br2)$(li)$(thing)/element item weapon add <element>$()$(br2)Requires a held item that has attack damage and attack speed. Marks it so it always carries that Aspect.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)/element item armor add <element> [points] [resist element] [resist points]$()$(br2)Requires a held armour piece (it must have an armour value). Example: $(thing)armor add fire 50 frost 25$().

pages.title: Forced entities
pages.text: Hold a $(thing)spawn egg$() and run:$(br2)$(thing)/element entity add <attack element> [enh element] [enh points] [res element] [res points]$()$(br2)Applied to every mob of that type the next time it is generated near a player.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)entity remove$() deletes the entry - existing mobs keep their gear.$(li)$(thing)/element biome$() reads the element bias of the biome you are standing in, and can add or remove entries.

pages.title: Attribute blacklist
pages.text: Holding a spawn egg:$(br2)$(thing)/element entity blacklist add <element|all>$()$(br2)$(li)$(thing)all$() - the mob never gains any element.$(li)A single element, e.g. $(thing)fire$() - the mob may still be Frost, Thunder or Nature, but never Fire, as an attacker, an enhancement or a resistance.$(li)$(thing)entity blacklist remove <element|all>$()$(li)$(thing)entity blacklist list$()$(br2)Written as $(thing)"minecraft:zombie:fire"$() in the config file.
